Rate_Capability.source_text: LiLCO cells with various electrolytes deliver similar specific discharge capacity in the first 20 cycles, after which the cells with base and PB electrolytes drastically drop below 100 mAh g⁻¹ when the current density is enhanced to 1.5 C, and severe deterioration occurs when the current density is further increased to 2 C. In contrast, cells with PN and PBN electrolytes maintain apparently higher capacities of 139.3 and 159.3 mAh g⁻¹ at 1.5 C, and the capacity moderately drops to 118.2 and 137.2 mAh g⁻¹ after raising the current density to 2 C. When the current density is set back to 0.2 C, cells with PN and PBN electrolytes still remain high capacities of 163.2 and 150.1 mA h g⁻¹, which is superior to the cells with the base electrolyte 123.3 mAh g⁻¹ and PB electrolyte 128.4 mAh g⁻¹. Similar results are observed for LiNCM811 cells. The cells with PN and PBN electrolytes exhibit large discharge capacities of 107.0 and 120.3 mAh g⁻¹ at 2 C, which are apparently higher than that of PB electrolyte of 45.9 mA h g⁻¹ and base electrolyte of 35.2 mAh g⁻¹.

materials.name: 1M LiPF6 in EC/DMC/DEC (1:1:1 v/v)
materials.description: Conventional carbonate baseline electrolyte used by Hu's group; poor high-temperature stability with severe µSi particle cracking

materials.name: 1M LiPF6 in EC/DMC (commercial carbonate electrolyte)
materials.description: Standard commercial carbonate-based electrolyte forming brittle organic-dominated SEI, widely used as reference

materials.name: 0.5M LiFSI high-concentration electrolyte
materials.description: High-concentration LiFSI electrolyte forming denser, thinner LiF-rich SEI, reducing µSi/C particle expansion to 8.7% after 500 cycles

materials.name: LiFSI additive with LiPO2F2 corrosion inhibitor electrolyte
materials.description: LiFSI as additive with LiPO2F2 to passivate Al current collector corrosion; achieved 94.6% capacity retention after 100 cycles

materials.name: LiTFSI-dominated electrolyte for pre-lithiated µSi
materials.description: LiTFSI-based electrolyte forming LiF/Li2CO3 dual-phase SEI on pre-lithiated µSi anodes, balancing mechanical strength and flexibility

materials.name: LiNO3/LiTFSI in THF ether electrolyte
materials.description: Ether-based electrolyte with LiNO3 and LiTFSI salts strengthening anion-solvent interactions; µSiOx anode only 12% thickness expansion, stable over 500 cycles in full cells

materials.name: LiBOB-VC fluorine-free carbonate electrolyte
materials.description: Fluorine-free electrolyte based on LiBOB and VC additives forming oxygen-rich flexible SEI; outperforms fluorinated LiPF6-FEC-VC counterpart

materials.name: LiBH4-based fluorine-free electrolyte for µSi
materials.description: F-free electrolyte using LiBH4 to chemically pre-lithiate native oxide layer; forms 2nm Li2SiO3 layer, achieves 94.3% retention after 100 cycles

materials.name: LiPF6/EC/DEC/DMC + 5% TFPC co-solvent electrolyte
materials.description: Carbonate electrolyte with 5% fluorinated co-solvent TFPC forming organic-inorganic bilayer SEI; 77.6% capacity retention after 500 cycles at 1C

materials.name: FEMC regular concentration electrolyte (FEMC-RCE)
materials.description: Fluoroethyl methyl carbonate replacing EMC to form F-rich flexible organic SEI outer layer with rigid LiF inner layer

materials.name: FEMC localized high-concentration electrolyte (FEMC-LHCE)
materials.formula: LiFSI in FEMC + non-solvating diluent (high concentration)
materials.description: Localized high-concentration FEMC electrolyte with non-solvating diluent; enables SiMP||NMC811 (640 Wh/kg) and SiMP||LNMO (408 Wh/kg) full cells

materials.name: DOL/DME ether electrolyte with LiNO3 additive
materials.description: Ether-based DOL/DME mixture with LiNO3 additive; poor cycling stability on µSi due to unfavorable SEI properties and DOL polymerization

materials.name: 4MDOL-based ether electrolyte with polymerization-confined SEI
materials.description: Methylated DOL (4-methyl-1,3-dioxane) electrolyte confining ring-opening polymerization to the interface, forming elastic polymer-rich SEI for µSi volume regulation

materials.name: 2M LiPF6 in THF/MTHF (1:1 v/v) ether electrolyte
materials.description: High-concentration LiPF6 in cyclic ether mixture forming low-adhesion LiF-rich SEI; µSi achieves 2800 mAh/g and 5.6 mAh/cm² over 400 cycles

materials.name: EGDE-LiPF6 medium-concentration linear ether electrolyte
materials.description: Ethylene glycol dibutyl ether with LiPF6 forming stratified SEI (inner LiF/Li3PO4, outer polyether); µSi retains 1901 mAh/g with 99.92% CE after 500 cycles
